# Audien Hearing

> Audien Hearing offers FDA-approved OTC hearing aids and accessories with risk-free trials, available online and at major U.S. retailers including Walmart, CVS, and Walgreens.

Audien Hearing specializes in affordable, accessible hearing solutions through their Atom series products (Atom ONE, Atom 2, Atom Pro 2) featuring advanced A2 chip technology. The company combines direct-to-consumer online sales with major retail partnerships to make medical-grade hearing aids widely available.
